The search-retrieval-quality standard covers actual search adapters and injection delivery. An all-source offline stage experiment is a separate population. Reuse the existing benchmark, sampler, relevance evaluator, prompt records and scorecard seams; there is no parallel quality store.

## Freeze the study before executing

Declare population, client/port/adapter, observation interval, eligibility, paired opportunity IDs, known relevant facts/items, applicable stages, effective runtime/embedding/score/fusion/filter/budget contract, corpus/fixture/judge/prompt/sample fingerprints, practical effect margin, numeric decision policy and confidence method. A changed contract invalidates historical comparison. Freeze queries/census once for both arms; running the same seed against a growing census does not freeze inputs.

Actual injection prompt records must be sampled separately from search-tool invocations. Preserve distinct-query diversity and usage-weighted experience as separately named analyses. Sampling covers one/two terms, identifiers, follow-ups and longer queries; absent buckets cannot support a short-query verdict.

## Maintained benchmark route

Run the CLI dry probe first. It samples a bounded 30-day interval by default and includes one/two-term queries; specify the same --since/--until for every paired arm. The frozen census, allocation, queries, usage counts and fingerprints travel with the artifact.

```bash
npx tsx packages/operator-core/lib/search/bench/labelled-relevance-cli.ts --dry-run --queries 20 --seed context-quality-oct09 --since 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z --until 2026-10-09T00:00:00Z --min-terms 1 --max-terms 2
```

A full paid relevance pass requires a current positive/negative/double-scored judge pilot meeting a numeric policy declared BEFORE the run, with denominators, model/prompt/input fingerprints, uncertainty and nonzero provider input/output tokens. Cache reuse needs the same exact contract. Do not interpret old pilot flip ranges or qualitative 'near one' as a current executable acceptance bar. Paid runs must use deliberate bounded budgets; do not schedule recurring judging by default.

The CLI adapter is an offline all-source hybrid/reranking stage experiment. It does not faithfully reproduce every tool or injection port from which queries were sampled. Corpus contents need an independently resolved fingerprint; null is unknown rather than a guessed identity.

## Arithmetic, engagement and complete denominators

Uniform positive gain has nDCG1; uniform zero gain has nDCG0. Both are invariant to permutation and uninformative about ordering. Returned-set nDCG is not recall or overall context quality. Precision divides relevant returned hits by returned hits up to k: one relevant at k10 gives precision1 with returnedCount1. Historical pollutionRate counts grade0 top-k documents, hit-weighted; accessoryAtK counts grades≤1. Do not concatenate poolHits and hits.

Stage engagement is attempted/scored/input/output provenance. An optimal order can remain unchanged after a functioning reranker. Use both an already-optimal control and a deliberately reorderable control. Preserve the complete paired attempt population when one arm fails; prespecified eligible-stage results are an additional estimand.

The v2 benchmark keeps historical conditional ranking fields and adds attempted/outcome counts, requested/returned slots, underfill, independently labelled useful success/failure/unknown, missing known IDs and known-item recall. Failed retrieval and failed judges remain recorded, including paid cost from drained workers. A failed leg differs from a successful zero-match leg. groundTruthIds absent means usefulness/recall unknown; [] means independently confirmed no needed item, so successful empty context can be correct abstention. The useful-success lower bound uses ALL attempts and is not an estimated success rate for unlabelled opportunities.

Zero-event binomial bounds require a stated independent event model; paired continuous deltas and dependent repeat queries require paired/clustered confidence methods. Small or unexercised strata are unknown. No single run establishes a production floor.

## Final delivery and task utility

Judge exact final snippets and assembled blocks, including content beyond selected annotations. Independently resolve correctness/currentness/authority/scope, corrections and supersession. Necessary negations, approval conditions, dates and recovery references must survive. A highly relevant unauthorized or condition-stripped instruction fails independently of precision. Use assessDeliveredContext on exact prompt records; unit fixtures test the assessor, not production quality.

The concrete reducer is assessPairedTaskUtility in labelled-relevance.ts. It reuses @papercusp/bench-metrics pairedBootstrapCI over equal-weight source-cluster means, preserves every frozen pair ID and unknown arm, checks blinded independent outcome references and matching model/task/tools/budget contracts, and records tokens/latency/cost separately. Harmful effects fail independently of a positive aggregate; an underpowered or incompletely observed comparison stays unknown. The reducer's fixture success is not a live agent replay.

For task benefit use a blinded held-out paired replay set with identical model/tasks/tools/budgets. Independently verify outcomes and harmful effects; report paired effect, confidence, practical margin, avoided searches and latency/token/cost tradeoffs. Quoting a memory is not task benefit. Preserve failing arms and abstentions. Useful facts per token and marginal benefit have separate names from relevance. Missing independent paired outcomes makes task utility unknown.

## Recurrence guards and scorecards

```bash
PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS=papercusp npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/search/bench/labelled-relevance.test.ts packages/operator-core/lib/search/bench/query-sample.test.ts packages/operator-core/lib/memory/injection-delivery-coverage.test.ts packages/operator-core/lib/memory/corpus-recall.test.ts
```

Before live probes choose dev:pipeline_position(path,testClass:'operator-api') and verify servingRuntimes. A route gap is not executable. Use scorecards:evaluate, fill the complete current criterion set, validate/emit, then inspect saved ratings and scorecards:freshness/trend. Existing named search instruments have no computed authority unless the registry resolves them; explicit manual/self-reported provenance is mandatory. Unit test passes certify guards only. Healthy quality needs current measured evidence; unknown includes an owned next evidence action.
